scope: Ethereum LINK queue deposit, caller stLINK distribution claim, unqueue/redemption, and finalized LINK withdrawal claim.

strategyDataInterpretationEvidence.decision: Retain deposit and withdraw: downstream bytes encode uint64 vault index arrays, not user-selected call targets, selectors or executable calldata.

configurationObservation.limitations: Configuration getters were read at this block only to bind downstream source review. This is not a transaction simulation, eth_getCode/bytecode comparison, storage/proxy-slot attestation, future configuration guarantee, liquidity check or successful execution claim. Etherscan readContract endpoint returned a challenge. A second RPC endpoint returned HTTP 525 and supplies no corroborating evidence.

stakingPool.semantics: _depositLiquidity loops strategies ascending; _withdrawLiquidity loops descending. Both derive strategy = IStrategy(strategies[index]) from configured storage, take strategyData = _data.length > 0 ? _data[index] : bytes("") and invoke the fixed deposit(uint256,bytes) or withdraw(uint256,bytes) interface. The caller cannot encode a replacement strategy address or selector.

strategies.name: CommunityVCS
strategies.semantics: CommunityVCS.deposit is onlyStakingPool/notDuringDepositUpdate, updates vault limits then delegatecalls stored vaultDepositController with abi.encodeWithSelector(VaultDepositController.deposit.selector, _amount, _data). withdraw is onlyStakingPool/notDuringDepositUpdate and calls the inherited fixed-selector controller withdrawal. Neither selector nor delegatecall target comes from _data.

strategies.name: OperatorVCS
strategies.semantics: Inherited VaultControllerStrategy deposit/withdraw are onlyStakingPool and delegatecall stored vaultDepositController using the corresponding compile-time VaultDepositController selector. Caller bytes are an argument, not a delegatecall target or arbitrary payload.

vaultDepositController.semantics: Bound VaultDepositController.deposit and withdraw both execute uint64[] memory vaultIds = abi.decode(_data, (uint64[])). _depositToVaults validates the continuing groupDepositIndex and vaultIndex < globalState.depositIndex, loads IVault vault = vaults[vaultIndex], and calls vault.deposit(amount). Withdrawal validates continuing withdrawalIndex and membership in current unbonded group, loads IVault vault = vaults[vaultIds[i]], and invokes fixed getters and vault.withdraw(amount). No supplied bytes are forwarded as executable calldata to a user target. Vaults and controller remain administrator-configured storage, not caller-selected addresses. Malformed/missing per-strategy arrays or invalid/currently unavailable vault order may revert.

strategyDataInterpretationEvidence.executionBoundary: Evidence applies to the observed configured implementation/controller chain, not arbitrary future upgrades. Existing signing, authorization and nested execution rules are unchanged; no generic executor or delegatecall capability is introduced.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Current official deployment table identifies Ethereum LINK PriorityPool and WithdrawalPool; current queue/withdrawal reference describes ordinary deposits, caller Merkle claims and FIFO withdrawals. Official repository archived=false, disabled=false, pushed_at=2026-10-16T14:43:44Z. No reviewed official source labels these LINK deployments retired, sunset or wind-down. Maintenance signals are not DAU, TVL or fresh runtime availability evidence.

limitations: Inventory admission only; block-specific configuration getter evidence does not attest runtime identity, funding, liquidity, pause-state or transaction execution.
LINK approval is separate; stLINK approval is required when redeeming stLINK. No permit/callback/executor capability is admitted.
Deposits may remain queued. reSDL priority and deposit-room availability govern processing; users without reSDL can wait indefinitely while prioritized users remain.
Merkle claims/unqueue may require current distribution amounts/shares and IPFS-derived proof; no oracle/root-update authority is admitted.
Queued withdrawal requires protocol finalization followed by fixed WithdrawalPool.withdraw with caller-owned request and correct batch IDs.
Strategy bytes[] only feeds configured staking strategies; it is not arbitrary address/calldata execution and does not expand existing execution scope.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Ethereum LINK-specific deployment table, not POL/ESP pools; Sourcify exact address proxy resolution binds applicable implementation.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full deployed implementation ABI and source from exact-address Sourcify response; match labels retained literally (match is not exact_match). Proxy ABI retained when supplied. V2 proxy absent from Sourcify, bound by Etherscan Exact Match TransparentUpgradeableProxy page displaying implementation. No generic ERC4626 interface, repository-only ABI or fresh RPC attestation.
